statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has recent transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient reported brief episodes of neurological deficits
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to optimize rate and rhythm control strategies
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on failure to obtain required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
